artworks.title: Three Auca Children
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image displays three individuals standing together. The two on the left face forward, while the one on the right is turned slightly to the side. Each has distinct facial features with dark, medium-length hair decorated with feathers. They have neutral expressions and stand in a relaxed posture. Their lower bodies are minimally clothed, and they wear various ornaments like necklaces. The person on the far left is crossing their arms, the middle one holds a bow and arrow, and the person on the right leans on a decorated spear. The background is a simple, green landscape with soft skies.

artworks.title: A Puelchee Chief and Two Young Warriors
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three men standing together. The person on the left holds a bow and arrow. The central figure holds a spear. The person on the right holds a shield and a club. All three have feathers in their hair and wear minimal clothing. They have distinct facial features and long, dark hair. The background is neutral with soft colors.

artworks.title: Patagon Chief, His Brother, and Daughter
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals standing in a straight line facing forward. From left to right, there is a young girl wearing a dress and beaded necklaces, a man with long hair and a feather, a naked child, and a man with long dark hair holding a stick. The background is a painted setting with muted earth tones, faded greens, and a subtle blue sky.

artworks.title: Three Young Tobos Men
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: Three individuals are depicted in full-body portraits. The central figure stands with one leg crossed over the other, holding a spear adorned with feathers. They have long black hair with feathers, a beaded necklace, and wear minimal clothing. To the left, another individual stands holding a pipe, with long black hair with feathers, minimal clothing, and anklets made of feathers. On the right is the third figure holding a bow and arrow, wearing similar attire and a necklace, with long black hair. The background is a light, neutral field with hints of green, and the artwork is framed with a green border.

artworks.title: Four Fuegian Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals standing upright side by side. Three men have long, dark, slightly wavy hair falling around their shoulders, while the woman has long hair styled into two braids. The first man on the left holds a paddle and wears a necklace and a waist covering. The second man has a colorful necklace, a similar waist covering, and holds a staff. The third individual in the center carries a stick and wears a necklace. The woman on the right wears a woven skirt, a simple top, and multiple necklaces, holding up a net on posts. They stand on a beach with the ocean to the left and a boat behind them. The background reveals green, pointed trees. The sky is painted in soft hues merging into the landscape.

artworks.title: The Great Ant-Eater
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The scene depicts a small clearing in a dense forest. A person is in a hammock, while another is cooking over a fire. An anteater is walking nearby. The painting shows detailed textures in the leaves and bark, with deep greens and browns dominating the color palette.

artworks.title: The Handsome Dance - Goo-a-give
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures standing in the foreground. They have long, dark hair styled up with feathers, wear necklaces, and have minimal attire with feather elements around their waists and legs. They hold long sticks adorned with feathers. The background shows a natural landscape with grass, a distant mountain range, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Ostrich Chase, Buenos Aires - Auca
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with rolling plains and sloping hills in the background. A rider on a galloping horse is depicted aiming a firearm at birds in flight. The painting features detailed brushwork capturing movement. The color palette includes earth tones and muted colors, with green, brown, and soft yellow dominating. The sky is filled with swirling clouds in pink and orange hues. Lush vegetation with green strokes and small colorful flowers can be seen close to us. Additional riders in the distance are engaged in similar activities.

artworks.title: Pont de Palmiers and Tiger Shooting
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a serene river landscape from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon is near the upper third of the painting with a dense strip of forest lining the riverbanks in the distance. Two animals are scavenging for food on a sandy bank to the right, and to the left, near us, a small canoe with two figures is quietly paddling. The brushstrokes are smooth and detailed, capturing the lush foliage and gentle ripples on the water. The color palette is natural with rich greens of the vegetation contrasting with soft blues and earthy tones of the river and sky.

artworks.title: Turtle Hunt
artworks.medium: oil on canvas
artworks.description: This is a painting of multiple figures in a jungle or forest setting at night, illuminated by torches. The scene shows the figures moving through dense foliage with large leaves and tall trees under a dark sky. The painting focuses on the contrast between the warm light of the torches and the deep shadows. It is in the style of Henri Rousseau, known for his jungle scenes, capturing motion and exploration in the dark, vegetative landscape.

artworks.title: A Fight with Peccaries - Caribbe
artworks.medium: oil on canvas
artworks.description: The image shows a forest scene with dense greenery, trees, and wild boars moving across a glade. The painting features realistic details like leaves and tree trunks, with a color palette of greens, earth tones, and soft browns and reds. Two figures in different attire observe the scene, while another figure stands on a fallen trunk holding a spear.

artworks.title: Ignis Fatuus - Zurumati
artworks.medium: oil on canvas
artworks.description: The image shows a dense jungle with an illuminated path leading through it. The horizon is faintly visible in the distance, created by trees and foliage. The dense greenery is depicted with intricate brushstrokes, enhancing the texture of the scene. The color palette consists of rich greens and browns, with highlights of orange and yellow where light hits the foreground. In the distance, cooler and darker colors like blue and gray add depth. On the right, there is a group of figures partially visible among the foliage and shadows.

artworks.title: View of the Pampa del Sacramento
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape seen from an elevated perspective, with a vast expanse stretching out. The horizon is high, revealing distant mountain peaks partly covered in mist. There are smooth brushstrokes depicting a lush scenery with rich earth tones and green hues for hills and trees, while the sky is blue with soft pink and white clouds. Figures are gathered on a hill slope, with sparse vegetation around them. Trees spread out in clusters leading to misty mountains in the distance. The scene conveys a sense of tranquility and space in nature.

artworks.title: Shore of the Essequibo
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts a serene landscape with a body of water in the distance. A lush rainforest is on the right, and a small encampment with people is closer to the viewer. The scene is detailed with subtle brushstrokes and a color palette dominated by greens and earthy tones.

artworks.title: Luxuriant Forest on the Bank of the Amazon
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The painting depicts a lush jungle with dense foliage blocking the horizon. In the distance, a small body of water can be seen with boats carrying figures. The brushstrokes create textures depicting the tropical vegetation, using a color palette dominated by green shades with some brown and black accents, along with splashes of red and blue.

artworks.title: A Caribbe Village in Dutch Guiana
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a tropical setting with lush foliage, trees, and hut-like structures. The perspective is slightly elevated, offering a comprehensive view. The painting features detailed textures and fine brushstrokes, primarily in green tones with hints of brown. In the distance, structures and figures are visible, suggesting a small community. A body of water runs parallel to the viewer, bordered by more vegetation.

artworks.title: View in the Crystal Mountains
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape view framed within an oval shape. In the center, there is a vast mountain range. The horizon is elevated, with mountains stretching across the midsection of the scene and blending into indistinct hills towards the right. Below the horizon, there is a lush expanse of trees with a group of figures gathered around a fire in the lower right. The sky above transitions from light blue to muted gray with a touch of pink. The overall color palette is dominated by earthy greens and browns with subtle highlights of pink and blue.

artworks.title: Arowak Village
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a painted scene viewed through an oval frame with a soft, muted border. The perspective places the observer at a ground level, looking onto a village setting with lush trees and tall plants in the foreground. Beyond the village, there is dense jungle foliage. Small houses with pitched roofs are visible along the horizon. The brushstrokes are delicate and precise, creating a soft, dreamlike quality in the scene. The color palette is dominated by earthy greens and browns with lighter shades suggesting an overcast sky.

artworks.title: The Beetle Crevice
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a canyon from a high vantage point. The oval-shaped canyon is framed within a square canvas. The horizon is positioned towards the upper part of the image with sky and clouds. On the horizon, there are rock formations and greenery. The right side of the image shows a cliff edge with small figures engaged in activities. The brushstrokes are fluid and subtle, particularly in the sky and rock textures, creating depth. The color palette consists of earthy tones like browns and greens for the rocks and vegetation, contrasting with the bright sky. The scene depicts an expansive and rugged terrain with a river running through it.

artworks.title: Shore of the Trombetas
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts a dense jungle scene viewed from slightly above water level. The horizon is obscured by thick greenery, including palm fronds, vines, and colorful flowers. In the foreground, a narrow canoe-like boat carries three figures: one standing in the boat and two working by the water's edge. The detailed brushwork emphasizes the leaves and foliage, creating a rich tapestry of greens with bright blossoms. The earth-toned border complements the lush wilderness depicted, drawing the viewer into the jungle.

artworks.title: An Indian Village - Shore of the Amazon
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard

artworks.title: Interior of an Amazon Forest - Zurumati
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a dense jungle scene observed from a slight distance, providing a panoramic perspective. The horizon is hidden by lush tree canopies and vegetation, creating a continuous visual flow. The painting features intense brushstrokes depicting thick leaves and tall tree trunks, conveying depth in the foliage. The color palette is mainly rich greens with darker shadows, creating a dim jungle ambiance. Small figures wearing red attire are scattered throughout the scene, along with tiny flowers, adding a subtle contrast. The figures seem to be moving across the terrain, adding dynamism to the forest.

artworks.title: An Amazon Forest - Looking Ashore
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard

artworks.title: Rhododendron Mountain
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with lush greenery, rolling hills, trees, a path, and small figures. The sky is blue with wispy clouds. The painting features soft brushstrokes blending different shades of green and earth tones. The color palette includes green, earth tones, and blue.
